fields.FIR_Description: During the morning of 2026-02-14, around 08:00, a green scooter bearing registration number TN-38-XX-1069 of the complainant was reported missing from Mullai Colony Shopping Complex, according to the complaint recorded on 2026-02-14. The complaint was lodged by Manoj Sekar (9000000489). A person named Madhan Murugan, associated with the number 9000000216, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. Siva Selvam (9000000440), described as a co-worker, was also mentioned in the complaint. The complainant mentioned CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Vehicle allegedly taken after the handle lock was forced.
